acceptanceCriteria: The script resolves the repository root from its own path and builds there, whatever the caller's cwd.
A test runs the script from outside the repository.
body: Found 2026-09-25 while fixing V1-0346 (PR #243). script/local-console-release-gate runs `go build ./cmd/...` without first changing to the repository root, so running it from any other directory builds the wrong tree or fails.
